newsitem.title: JAPAN: Taka-Q bid-only on Esprit joint venture plans.
newsitem.headline: Taka-Q bid-only on Esprit joint venture plans.

text.p: Taka-Q Co Ltd shares were bid-only early on Monday morning on the firm's plan to form a joint venture with a Bermuda-based holding company of Esprit Holdings Ltd, brokers said.
As of 0034 GMT, the shares of the men's apparel manufacturer and retailer were bid-only at 321 yen after closing at 311 yen in the previous session.
The joint venture firm will be established in July with starting capital of 200 million yen, a spokesman for Taka-Q said.
The spokesman denied a weekend report in the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun that the new firm will take over about 10 of Taka-Q's men's apparel shops and make them into Esprit shops.
"The new firm will open new shops on its own," he said.
The spokesman said further details about the joint venture would be announced later in the day.
